pages.title: About – Logistea
pages.main_text_excerpt:
Logistea’s growth is based on acquisitions, investments in existing assets and development of brand new facilities in partnership with existing and new tenants. Sustainability is always central to our growth, which is made possible by a strong financial position thanks to stable cash flows generated by long-term, reliable tenants.
Logistea operates in a growing niche where the demand for efficient warehouse and logistics management is increasing with the transformation of retail.
A long-term North European portfolio in attractive locations
Strong financial position
With financially strong owners, solid finances and stable revenue streams, Logistea can realise a strategy for growth that paves the way to long-term sustain able value. The major acquisition of KMC Properties has, on completion of the merger, lent us a critical mass that further underpins this argument.
Diversified and long-term customer base
Logistea’s tenants are financially stable businesses operating across a wide range of sectors and industries, which reduces our risks of rental losses and vacancies. Low vacancies and long leases consisting above all of triple net leases with full CPI adjustment deliver predictably steady cash flows over time.
Ability to do good business
Logistea’s efficient and right-sized organisation makes an experienced team, with an extensive transactional background, that identifies good property deals and development opportunities without losing focus on active management. We deliver on our strategy to create value through acquisitions.
The fact that we doubled our property portfolio during the year in no way means that we feel we have done enough – we are committed to continue growing in our segment. As before, the focus remains on developing and acquiring properties that are let to financially well-established tenants wishing to expand and develop the premises in partnership with us, the property owners. Our growth will continue to advance on several fronts, with acquisitions of individual properties and portfolios, a high pace of investment in our existing portfolio and evaluation of new possible mergers.

pages.title: About personal data – Logistea
pages.main_text_excerpt:
We at Logistea AB appreciate your visit to our website. We want you to know that we care about your privacy and always strive to protect your personal data in the best way possible. We hereby want to inform you on how we will use your personal data and what rights you have.
How is your personal data used?
Logistea AB stores and uses the personal data that is collected from you. Logistea AB is committed to protecting your privacy when you visit this and other Internet websites of the Logistea AB. The processing of personal data that occurs when you visit the websites and utilize Logistea AB’s services, as well as the rights you have under the Personal Data Act (Swedish – Personuppgiftslagen (1998:204)), are described briefly herein. Unless otherwise is specifically stated when you provide personal data, Logistea AB, reg. no 556627-6241, is responsible for the processing of your personal data.
You have the opportunity to ask questions, to order data or to contact Logistea AB through contact and order forms on the website. When making an order or requesting contact, we ask you to enter such information that is necessary for us to comply with your request and for continued contact regarding the matter at hand, e.g. name, address, telephone number, e-mail address or other personal data. Logistea AB only uses the personal data to fulfil the relevant purpose. The data may be disclosed to Logistea AB’s partners when the partner has been engaged to administer the distribution of the relevant material or information, but will not otherwise be disclosed to others. In each context where you provide personal data, you receive more specified information and give your consent to how your personal data is processed.
If you subscribe to our press releases
If you choose to subscribe to our press releases you will be asked to provide certain personal data about yourself, such as your name and email address. Your information will be used to administer the press releases. If you choose to end your subscription, your personal data will be deleted.
Who protects your personal data?
Logistea AB has taken technical measures to ensure that the data is protected against destruction through accident, against any modification, unauthorized circulation of or unauthorized access to the data, as well as any other kind of unauthorized processing of the data.
Your rights
Once per calendar year, after a written request addressed to Logistea AB at the address specified below, you have the right to receive information on what personal data Logistea AB has registered about you free of charge.
You also have the right to, at any time, request correction of incorrect data, to modify information that you have previously provided, or to revoke a granted consent and notify that you oppose further processing of your personal data, or that you do not wish to receive continued information from Logistea AB. Your personal data will in that case be deleted as soon as possible with regards to any undertakings Logistea AB may have towards you.
In order to satisfy your requests, we ask you to provide complete information and to specify the context in which you have provided Logistea AB with data. Without this information we do not have the possibility to verify, correct or delete information.
You can make requests as follows:
By e-mail to info@logistea.se or by mail to:
Personuppgiftsombudet
Logistea AB
P.O. Box 5089
SE-102 42 Stockholm
Sweden

pages.title: Career – Logistea
pages.main_text_excerpt:
At Logistea, we build more than properties – we build sustainable returns.
We are a fast-growing real estate company with a focus on modern and sustainable logistics and warehouse properties. Our goal is to create long-term value for our customers, investors and society – and for that we need committed people who want to be involved and make a difference.
At Logistea, you get the chance to grow – both professionally and personally. We believe in freedom under responsibility, a strong team and that every individual has the opportunity to influence.
We invest in our employees. With us, you get access to skills development and the opportunity to shape your own career journey.
We work actively with environmental and social sustainability goals. As part of Logistea, you are part of building a sustainable society – for real
We are in an expansive phase and are constantly looking for new ways forward. Here, you get to be part of the development, think new things and take your place.
We are a close-knit group with diverse backgrounds and experiences. With offices in Stockholm, Borås and Trondheim, we have assembled an experienced and dynamic organization that believes in collaboration and open communication.
